description: "Self-Raised; Or, From the Depths" by Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth is a novel likely written in the late 19th century. The story delves into the emotional and moral struggles faced by its main character, Ishmael, as he transitions from despair after losing his beloved, Claudia, to a journey of personal growth and resilience, aided by the unwavering support of his devoted friend, Bee.
